newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks moving in late trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks moving in late trading.

text.p: The stock market's downward momentum halted when the bell rang Thursday, with few stocks moving in either direction after regular hours, traders said.
"There wasn't any big news that would drive prices one way or another," one trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 4,400, compared to Wednesday's 90,700. Session two volume was 2,508,350, while on Wednesday it was 7,597,800.
